entries.headline: Yordan Alvarez came close
entries.story: Yordan Alvarez went 3-for-5 with 1 RBI against Will Warren and the New York Yankees. Closest call was a triple in the 8th: "Yordan Alvarez triples (1) on a sharp line drive to right fielder Spencer Jones. Jeremy Peña scores." The power showed up; the carry did not.
